labelDefinition.meaning: County outage level materially increases within the lookahead window
labelDefinition.positiveClass: increase >= 500 customers OR future outage count >= 150% of current outage count
rules: Positive if customer outage increase is at least 500
Positive if current outage count is greater than zero and future outage count is at least 1.5x current outage count
Smaller increases are tracked as minor but not labeled positive
